title: 第15章 敢否第16章 十息之内斩我
content_zh:
第15章敢否？“不配？”
听到此话，凌子桓等人皆愤怒异常。
“一介废人，竟如此自视甚高？”
石缺忍不住出言讥讽道。
“你若不出手，我等便在战台上，所有白家之人上场，都会被轰下台去。
你有本事便坚持永不出战，任由白家在这次大比中全部落选！”
凌子桓傲立在战台之上，以他的身份，本不该说这样的话，但为了逼迫萧沉出手，他也顾不上这么多了。
石缺、冷苍，还有周凌安，都站在凌子桓身边，仿佛和他怀着同样的心思！
“你们真想跟我战，可以，生死不论，敢否？”
萧沉平静的神情下却吐出一道无比霸气的声音，使得众人的心都狠狠一颤。
面对远风城的四大天骄人物，萧沉只问了一句，生死不论，敢否！
这一句话，让众人的热血都有些沸腾。
然而，众人心中依旧不解，生死战，萧沉底气何在？
毒术么？
“有何不敢！”
凌子桓求之不得，“你主动求死，我自当成全你！”
“少城主小心有诈。”
周凌安在旁提醒了一句，随即看向萧沉，“你若承诺不用毒术，我等皆可与你生死战。”
石缺和冷苍轻轻点头，的确，萧沉的毒术是个巨大的威胁，连苦海八重的周家长老都能毒死。
听到周凌安的话，萧沉仰天大笑，“杀你们，何需用毒？你们，一起上吧！”

哗！
人群哗然，萧沉的狂妄超乎了他们的想象，在不用毒的情况下，他让凌子桓等人，一起上！
“狂妄至极！”
凌子桓的周身似卷起骇人的元气风暴，汇聚成一柄柄金刑之剑，如同一座剑阵般，要将萧沉绞杀。
萧沉的神情依旧风轻云淡，脚步朝着战台踏去，无数人的目光落在他的身上，神色各异。
想要他死的人，很多。
期待他的人，也有不少。
更多的人，则是好奇，他修为尽失，如何与四大天骄战斗？
“废物，受死吧！”
当萧沉脚步踏上战台的一刹那，一道身影瞬间朝着他冲击而来，他的整条手臂好似覆盖上了一层岩石铠甲，无比坚固。
轰咔！
萧沉抬手便是一拳震荡轰出，不死天功运转，他的拳头犹如战神之拳，战意澎湃，那攻杀而来岩石手臂当场爆裂，石缺的身体被直接震到了战台之下！
“想要击败我来洗刷你先前战败的耻辱吗？可惜，你选错了对手……废物！”
萧沉的嘴中吐出一道嘲讽的声音，让浑身是血的石缺气得昏死过去。
“这不可能！”
看到萧沉这一拳，周狂昭和周凌雪尽皆震惊不已，不敢相信他们眼睛看到的一切！
不止是他们，全场都愣住了，是谁管萧沉叫废物的？
有这么强悍的废物吗？
“我没有被废，周家应该很失望吧。”
萧沉抬头看了一眼周家的方向，“我说过，今日，会拿回属于我的一切！”
content_en:
Chapter 15 Dare you? "Not worthy?"
After hearing this, Ling Zihuan and others were extremely angry.
"How can a loser think so highly of himself?"
Shi Que couldn't help but sarcastically said.
"If you don't take action, we will be on the battlefield, and everyone from the Bai family will be kicked off the stage.
If you have the ability, insist on never fighting, and let the Bai family all lose in this competition! "
Ling Zihuan stood proudly on the battlefield. With his status, he shouldn't have said such words, but in order to force Xiao Chen to take action, he didn't care so much.
Shi Que, Leng Cang, and Zhou Ling'an were all standing next to Ling Zihuan, as if they had the same thoughts as him!
"If you really want to fight me, you can. No matter life or death, do you dare?"
Under Xiao Chen's calm expression, he uttered an extremely domineering voice that made everyone's hearts tremble.
Facing the four geniuses of Yuanfeng City, Xiao Chen only asked one question, life or death, do you dare!
This sentence made everyone's blood boil.
However, everyone is still confused. Where is Xiao Chen's confidence in a life and death battle?
Poison technique?
"Why don't you dare!"
Ling Zihuan didn't get what he wanted, "If you ask for death, I will take it upon myself to save you!"
"Young City Master, be careful of fraud."
Zhou Ling'an reminded him, then looked at Xiao Chen, "If you promise not to use poison, we can fight to the death with you."
Shi Que and Leng Cang nodded lightly. Indeed, Xiao Chen's poison technique was a huge threat. It could poison even the elders of the Zhou family in the eighth level of the Sea of Bitterness.
Hearing Zhou Ling'an's words, Xiao Chen looked up to the sky and laughed, "Why use poison to kill you? You all, come together!"
Wow!
The crowd was in an uproar. Xiao Chen's arrogance exceeded their imagination. Without using any poison, he asked Ling Zihuan and others to join him!
"Extremely arrogant!"
Ling Zihuan's body seemed to be surrounded by a terrifying storm of vitality, gathering into a golden sword, like a sword array, trying to strangle Xiao Chen.
Xiao Chen's expression was still calm and calm, and he stepped towards the fighting platform. Countless people's eyes fell on him with different expressions.
There are many people who want him dead.
There are many people who are looking forward to him.
More people are curious, how can he fight against the four geniuses when he has lost all his cultivation?
"Trash, suffer death!"
The moment Xiao Chen stepped onto the battlefield, a figure rushed towards him instantly. His entire arm seemed to be covered with a layer of rock armor, which was extremely strong.
Boom!
Xiao Chen raised his hand and punched out with a concussive punch. The Immortal Art was in motion. His fist was like the fist of the God of War. His fighting spirit was surging. The rock arm that came from the attack exploded on the spot, and Shi Que's body was directly shaken to the bottom of the fighting platform!
"Do you want to defeat me to wash away the shame of your previous defeat? Unfortunately, you chose the wrong opponent...trash!"
A mocking voice came out of Xiao Chen's mouth, which made Shi Que, who was covered in blood, faint from anger.
"This is impossible!"
Seeing Xiao Chen's punch, Zhou Kuangzhao and Zhou Lingxue were both shocked and couldn't believe what they saw!
Not only them, but the whole audience was stunned. Who called Xiao Chen a waste?
Is there such a powerful waste?
"The Zhou family must be very disappointed that I was not deposed."
Xiao Chen raised his head and glanced in the direction of the Zhou family, "I said, today, I will take back everything that belongs to me!"
